steps.learned_between_rounds: Round 1 left a workshop vs speaker tie and showed a weekday-evening need. Round 2 tested a combined option; it did not win clearly (speaker led 3 vs 2), so the choice is still soft.
steps.limits: Only 8 people; direction, not measurement. The tie was not cleanly broken, 2 of 8 chose none, and topics scattered. Flashpoint replies were labelled as practice stand-ins. No personas were run. Commander gave no guesses.
lessons: My guess of a social event on top was wrong; don't assume social events are favoured, and include practical/career options.
Adding a hybrid option after a tie did not decide it; with 8 people, use a forced trade-off or ranking in the first round.
Open answers revealed barriers (shift work, cliquey socials) that closed questions missed; keep an open barrier question.
